_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
O sa play Golf (Kati Game) - Player {player_id}.
Goal: Na scoro e lailai duadua ena gauna qo. Ia kece na kolomu e tautauvata na kena ivalor, e na qai taura ga me 0.
Na ivalor ni kati: A=1, 2-10=na ivalor, J/Q=10, K=0

Na veika (vakayagataki na veika e vakarautaki):
- '[draw]' - Kauta ena dekini
- '[take]' - Taura ena kena qai droini
- '[swap X Y]' - Solia na kati e kauta kei na vanua X (daku) Y (kolomu)
- '[discard]' - Droini na kati e kauta

board.drew: O sa droinitaka: {card} E dodonu mo qai [swap X Y] se [discard] kina.
board.took: O taura: {card} mai na iwiliwili ni biu laivi E dodonu mo [swap X Y] vata kei koya (sega ni rawa me biuta tani).
board.peeked: O ni raici kina na position ({row},{col}): {card}
board.none: Sega ni dua na kena itukutuku.

options.final_turns: Na gauna ni kava! Na nomuni itavi: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: E dodonu mo: [swap X Y] (sega ni rawa ni biu laivi na kadi mai na i binibini me kau tani)
options.swap_or_discard: O sa na: [swap X Y] se [discard]

action_desc.swapped: Player {pid} sa qai soli {new} kei {old} ena vanua ({row},{col})

message.deck_empty: Sa lala na deck! E sa cava sara ga oqo.
message.knocked: Player {pid} knocked! E dua tale na gauna me ra qai veimau.
message.final_round: Player {pid} {reason}! Na tamata yadua e na qai via vakayagataki e muri.

invalid.wrong_action: Kerekere, vakayagataka na veika e dua ga na ivalavala vakabeka: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], se [peek X Y]
invalid.discard_empty: Sa lala na iqaqi ni iyaya!
invalid.must_draw_first: O sa na qai [draw], [take], [knock], se [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: E sega ni rawa mo biuta laivi e dua na tikinivolatabu mai na iwiliwili levu, ia me veisau ga.
invalid.have_drawn_card: O sa qai kauta e dua na kati. O sa na [swap X Y] se [discard] koya.
invalid.need_drawn_swap: E vinakati me dua na tikinipepa e dusi mo veisautaka.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: E vinakati me dua na tikinivolatabu e volai tu mo biuta laivi.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Vanua sa tu vakalailai. Vakayagataki daku 1-{max_row}, kolomu 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: Ke o sega ni kila na ka e tu ena nomu kadi, mo vakaotia mada ga.
invalid.already_knocked: E dua e sa bau taura na iotioti ni gauna oqo.
invalid.already_revealed: Sa vakaraitaki oti na tikinivolatabu qori!

board_str.title: === QELE TEEVI NI GOLF ===
board_str.discard: Vakacacana na iwiliwili ni veika e biu tu: {card}
